_meta.description: Procedural requirements for filing a bail application, keyed by offense_category. Compiled from CrPC Chapter XXXIII (ss.436-450) and the corresponding BNSS 2023 chapter on bonds/bail bonds (ss.478-496), cross-referenced against the CrPC->BNSS official correspondence tables and Satender Kumar Antil v. CBI (2022) on standardising bond/surety practice.
_meta.legal_review_status: DRAFT - compiled from secondary legal sources, not yet verified against India Code primary text. See docs/LEGAL_VALIDATION_QUESTIONS.md.

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof (only if the court directs a surety bond)

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application citing the governing bond sections
Attach identity and residence proof to the application
File the application before the jurisdictional Magistrate/Sessions Court
Execute the personal bond in the amount fixed by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof and proof of solvency (property or income documents)
Bank statements or income-tax returns for the accused, where available
Undertaking not to tamper with financial records or witnesses

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application addressing flight-risk and evidence-tampering conditions typical in economic-offence matters
Assemble surety solvency documentation
File the application before the jurisdictional Sessions Court/Special Court where applicable (e.g. PMLA Special Court)
Execute the surety bond with sureties verified by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof and local address verification
Employer certificate or proof of occupation, where available

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application addressing any protection/no-contact conditions the court is likely to impose
Assemble surety and address-verification documentation
File the application before the jurisdictional Magistrate/Sessions Court
Execute the surety bond with sureties verified by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof and local address verification
Record of compliance with any pre-arrest notice requirements under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, where applicable

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof
Acknowledgement of any seized-device inventory issued by the investigating cyber cell

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application, noting whether the charged IT Act section is bailable or non-bailable
Assemble surety documentation and seized-device acknowledgement
File the application before the jurisdictional Magistrate/Sessions Court (or Special Court where the case also involves another special statute)
Execute the surety bond with sureties verified by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent

required_documents: Aadhaar or other government-issued photo ID
Passport (if held) and proof of current residence
Two sureties with ID proof and proof of property/solvency
Employer verification or proof of settled occupation

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application addressing the statutory bail restrictions that apply where a special statute (e.g. UAPA s.43D(5)) governs the charge
Assemble surety solvency and identity documentation
File the application before the jurisdictional Special Court/Sessions Court/High Court as required by the special statute
Execute the surety bond with sureties verified by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent

required_documents: Passport and visa copy
FRRO intimation record, where applicable
Two local sureties with ID proof
Proof of current residence in India

procedural_steps.description: Confirm bail eligibility status via the eligibility-engine before drafting the application
Draft the bail application including passport-surrender or travel-restriction conditions the court is likely to impose
Assemble passport/visa and local surety documentation
File the application before the jurisdictional Magistrate/Sessions Court
Execute the surety bond with sureties verified by the court
Obtain the release order and forward it to the jail superintendent, with a copy to the FRRO where applicable
